title: Zeke Chooses the Light
subtitle: Brave When Others Laugh
theme: Bravery when kids laugh at your faith

scripture_references.purpose: Courage because the Lord is with His people.
Jesus as the Light of the world and the Choose the Light theme.
Overcoming unkindness with kindness, forgiveness, and good.

pages.text: Zeke held his Bible close as he walked to school. His tummy felt fluttery, but his heart wanted to obey King Light.
When Zeke stepped into the hallway, some kids looked at his Bible. They whispered to each other, and Zeke’s smile got smaller.
The Whisper came close with a quiet lie. They will laugh at you, he seemed to say.
Zeke hugged his Bible tighter. He wanted to hide, but deep inside he knew God’s Word was true.
Some kids laughed and pointed. Zeke felt small, even though he was standing in the hallway.
Then warm light filled the place around him. King Light stood near Zeke with love in His eyes.
King Light placed peace in Zeke’s heart. His presence reminded Zeke, You are not alone.
Zeke looked up. The fear did not feel so big anymore.
King Light’s truth became stronger than the Whisper’s lie. Zeke remembered, Be strong and of a good courage.
Zeke took a deep breath. My Bible helps me remember that King Light is with me, he said.
The hallway became quiet. The kids stopped laughing and started listening.
Zeke did not yell. He spoke with kindness, because courage does not have to be mean.
One child looked down and felt sorry. I should not have laughed, he said softly.
Zeke looked at him with gentle eyes. It hurt, Zeke said, but I forgive you.
The child stepped closer. Zeke opened his hand, and peace began to grow.
Forgiveness made the hallway feel different. The Whisper grew weaker in the background.
Another child smiled at Zeke. I want to know why your Bible matters so much, she said.
Zeke held his Bible close. It reminds me that Jesus is the Light, and I do not have to be afraid.
The kids gathered around with kind faces. They were not laughing now. They were learning.
King Light smiled over them. Truth had turned fear into friendship.
Zeke and his new friends walked together. He still had his Bible, but now he did not feel alone.
Later, they sat together in a quiet place. Zeke opened his Bible, and the children listened with wonder.
They bowed their heads and prayed. Zeke thanked King Light for helping him be brave.
After school, Zeke walked home with peace in his heart. He knew King Light had been with him the whole day.
That evening, Zeke sat on his bed and remembered everything. He had felt afraid, but truth helped him stand.
Zeke knelt by his bed and prayed. King Light, thank You for helping me choose the light.
Zeke held his Bible and smiled. Peace was growing stronger inside his heart.
The room felt quiet and safe. The Whisper was outside, but he could not rule Zeke’s heart.
Zeke rested under his blanket. His Bible was near, and peace was even nearer.
King Light watched over Zeke with love. Zeke slept without fear.
Morning came with golden light. Zeke woke up knowing he could be brave again.
Zeke smiled and held his Bible close. When others laughed, he would choose the Light.
